# Takeoff

> Construction takeoff canvas that a person and an AI agent drive the same way. Open a plan (PDF, image, or .zip plan set), set the scale, trace areas — with one-click room detection and a 45°/90° angle lock — then apply waste % and per-condition supporting materials, and export quantities (SF/SY/LF/EA) as CSV/JSON. A person clicks the canvas; an agent calls the identical engine over MCP and gets the identical number, with the scale and origin of every measurement recorded. Built for flooring; the measuring engine works for any trade (drywall, paint, concrete, sitework). No account, no upload — plans never leave the machine.

A static web app: self-hosting is one `npm run build` and any static file host. The same engine answers to a person at the canvas or an AI agent over MCP — not two implementations.

## Docs

- [User guide & shortcuts](https://github.com/erikjohnstone/master-plan/blob/main/opentakeoff/docs/USER_GUIDE.md): every tool, keyboard shortcut, and the totals math
- [MCP / agent guide](https://github.com/erikjohnstone/master-plan/blob/main/opentakeoff/docs/MCP.md): how an agent opens a plan, adopts the scale, traces rooms, and exports a takeoff
- [Repository](https://github.com/erikjohnstone/master-plan): source, changelog, and contributor notes

## Key facts

- **Agent-native**: the same engine answers to a person at the canvas or an AI agent over MCP. Every shape records its provenance: scale, one-click or hand-drawn, and person or agent.
- **MCP server**: load a plan, read the title block, adopt the scale (never applied silently), one-click rooms, and export the same payload the app autosaves.
- Measuring: One-Click Area (flood-fill room detection from PDF vectors), Area, Rectangle, Linear, Surface-Area (walls), Count, Deduct
- Drawing aids: 45°/90° angle lock (polar tracking with ⇧ hard-lock, commits the on-axis point), live angle + segment-length readout at the cursor, endpoint snap
- Scale: auto-detects the drawn scale note per sheet, or calibrate from a known dimension
- Conditions: color + CAD hatch per finish, waste %, multiplier, wall height, border thickness
- Assemblies: per-condition supporting materials with coverage rates → rounded order quantities
- Reports: per-condition SF/SY/LF/EA with and without waste + a materials buy list; CSV/JSON export
- Storage: IndexedDB + localStorage only — client-side, private by construction
- Stack: React 18 + Vite + pdf.js; the whole app is a static build
